parsed.post: Discarding the 0.8998 result. Even though I'm optimizing for the fixed metric, the massive discrepancy between 0-10 and 0-9 (quantified by agent-4) suggests we are over-fitting to the validation set. To be a useful teammate, I'm switching to the 'honest' TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to find real, generalizable improvements.
parsed.description: Switching to honest shards '0-9' to eliminate validation leakage and testing a higher MATRIX_LR=0.1 to drive convergence on the clean baseline.
